title: Irreversibility of morphogenesis, not Weismann's barrier, is what limits Lamarckism

fields.label: Label
fields.value: Irreversibility of morphogenesis, not Weismann's barrier, is what limits Lamarckism

fields.label: Statement
fields.value: Because morphogenesis is a recursive, highly emergent process, the inverse problem of determining which genomic changes would produce a desired large-scale anatomical feature is in general unsolvable, and this irreversibility, rather than any inability to edit the germline in light of somatic experience, is what limits full-scale Lamarckian inheritance.

fields.label: Work
fields.value: Darwin's agential materials: evolutionary implications of multiscale competency in developmental biology

fields.label: Chapter
fields.value: Levin M 2023, Darwin's agential materials: evolutionary implications of multiscale competency in developmental biology › From genotype to phenotype in development: implications of an indirect pathway

fields.label: Quotation
fields.value: This irreversibility of the recursive, highly emergent process of morphogenesis is what limits full-scale Lamarckism: the difficulty is not how to penetrate Weismann’s barrier and edit the genome in light of somatic experience—mechanisms exist for this [21–23].

fields.label: Assumptions
fields.value: Levin M, “Darwin's agential materials: evolutionary implications of multiscale competency in developmental biology”, Cellular and molecular life sciences : CMLS (2023), doi:10.1007/s00018-023-04790-z; section “From genotype to phenotype in development: implications of an indirect pathway”. Scope: Metazoan development and inheritance in general

fields.label: Assessment
fields.value: GPT-5.6 Sol on levin-2023-agential-01: not-empirically-resolvable, resolvability 0.33

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: Restricted inverse morphogenesis problems are empirically and computationally testable. The universal impossibility and counterfactual historical comparison in the claim are not resolvable from existing datasets and lack a unique empirical consequence.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: One could benchmark inverse-design success for specified developmental models and target anatomies, but finite failures cannot establish that the general inverse problem is unsolvable or that this, rather than germline access, historically limits Lamarckian inheritance.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Full-scale Lamarckism is not a measurable endpoint.

'In general unsolvable' is not falsified by successes in selected systems.

Computational difficulty and biological historical limitation are conflated.

fields.label: Dimension scores
fields.value:
analysis feasibility: 0.3
discriminating power: 0.25
data existence: 0.45
operationalizability: 0.35
data adequacy: 0.25

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: Inversion difficulty can be measured on public developmental models, which is analysis of a proxy. Those models do not establish that real morphogenesis is unsolvable or that this, rather than transmission to the germline, is what limits Lamarckian inheritance across metazoans. The claim's full scope is not in any dataset.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: For published developmental models with an explicit genotype-to-anatomy map, attempt to recover parameter or genotype changes that produce a specified large-scale anatomical change, and compare success with and without a known route for somatic information to reach the germline. Systematic failure of inversion in well-specified models would support computational irreversibility as a barrier; reliable inversion, or empirical cases where a known edit produces a chosen organ-scale trait, would count against unsolvability as the limit on Lamarckian inheritance.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Existing models cover a negligible fraction of real genotype-to-anatomy maps.

Unsolvability in general depends on the model class and is not read out of metazoan datasets.
